steps.content: Like always, you follow them into the vessel as the "little guide" again, and manage to gather more insights into the expedition.

After a grim crisis several months ago, the expedition tracked the flames to the DisSea Border, where they set up their base camp. The team members assigned to investigate the DisSea and the Perishing Star have assembled submersibles and boats, already undertaking several diving and salvage operations.

steps.speaker: Forthright Male Voice
steps.content: ...Our mission this time is to retrieve the data collectors deployed during the last moonrise, and bring 'em back to Shin.

The Shin he mentioned seems to be the ocean scientist on their dive team. As for the two before you, there’s Ragnar—a robust, bearded middle-aged man who pilots the submarine—and Dale, a lean young man who, like Pylgia, works as a diver.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Who knows what's up with this damn sea? Only when the moon's out does that huge hole show up at the bottom. Then we gotta chuck the collectors down there during that tiny window and haul 'em back up when the moon rises again. It's a pain, I swear.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Ugh, honestly, this is ridiculous. The job's super urgent, but they just wouldn't cough up more help...

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Usually, Pylgia handles the collector retrieval on her own, but this time we got a tighter deadline, so Shin sent Ragnar and me to help out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's been doing this all alone?

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Yes, Pylgia's our best diver. There are many tasks that only she can take care of.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: You said it! She's a total champ in the water—better than any sea monster out there. Nothing can even keep up with her! Hey, Pylgia, is it true you can talk to deep-sea critters?
Pylgia offers no verbal response, standing alone in a far corner and letting an awkward silence permeate the air.
Seemingly well-acquainted with Pylgia's character, Ragnar displays no unease and continues talking in a relaxed manner.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: This mission's a big deal. Those collectors mean a lot to Shin's crew. We'll be counting on you to lead the way once we dive in, you good?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Actually...
Pylgia wants to speak, but hesitates for a few seconds before finding back her voice.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: You didn't need to come. I can handle it here.
Her tone lacks any trace of arrogance, nor the firmness expected in a refusal. Perhaps, she is simply concerned about the safety of her companions.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Things are different this time. All our collectors are down there—it's too many for you to manage alone.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Yep, right on the money. Those scientists keep yapping about how the seabed shifts with each tide, so we gotta grab all the collectors now—no chance you could handle that on your own.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: If we lose even one of those precious gadgets, we'll never hear the end of it from the folks on shore!
Faced with the barrage of words from the two men, Pylgia remains silent, only casting a gloomy glance at the porthole.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...I'll go check outside.
With that said, she opens the submarine's top hatch and climbs out.
Seeing Pylgia leave, Ragnar looks rather relaxed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Should we... take that as a yes?

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Yeah, it takes a bit of time to figure out how to work with her, but she's actually pretty reasonable—just not the most expressive person.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is really the heavy workload that you're here to help?

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Haha, a sharp little one, aren't you? Truth be told, we're mostly here 'cause we're worried about her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Worried? But you said she's the best diver you have.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: That's true, but things aren't safe beneath the surface lately. Last month, a three-person squad went on a mission and disappeared—haven't heard a peep so far.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Since our first dive six months ago, monster sightings have quadrupled. Pylgia's a pro at this, yes... but she's still human. If she keeps going solo like this, with no one watching her back during missions...

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: We're worried that one day she might run into a monster and...

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Ahem... Ragnar.
A noise emanates from the hatch as Dale adeptly interrupts the talk. Shortly after, Pylgia enters.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Equipments are all set. We can go now.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Right, time to hunt.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Pylgia, you handle the port side. Dale, you got the starboard. As for our guide... help me watch over this, will ya? Just keep an eye on this pressure gauge and give me a heads-up if anything seems off.
Following Ragnar's gesture, you spot a large set of levers and panels.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Let's roll!
The engines roar to life as seawater fills the ballast tanks, allowing the submarine to descend.
